resources.string: The Neo Geo BIOS (neogeo.zip) is missing. Put the file in the Jogos/BIOS folder or import it in Settings → BIOS. The app does not include BIOS files.
This game is an alternate version and needs the main romset %1$s. Copy it to the TV, in the same folder or another library folder.
FBNeo could not open this romset. It is incomplete or from another version (for example, an old MAME set). Use a romset compatible with FBNeo.
Little free memory for this game: it may close by itself. Close other apps if that happens.
The Neo Geo BIOS is incomplete. If the game does not start, replace neogeo.zip.
Choose a console above to see its options: 3 or 6 buttons and region (Mega Drive), FM sound (Master System), slowdown (Super Nintendo) and, in Arcade, FBNeo MVS/AES mode and free play.
In the FBNeo core: MVS is the arcade; AES, the home console.
Play without coins (FBNeo core, MVS mode).
6 buttons for fighting games; 3 buttons for old games that reject 6.
Automatic from the game, or force USA, Japan or Europe (50 Hz).
FM soundtrack in games that have it, like Japanese ones.
Speeds up the CPU and SuperFX chip. May glitch some games.
The Master System Pause button is on the controller\'s Start.
Coin is on Select; there is also "Insert coin" in the game menu.
